description: NEST is the Nexus Solutions Tool developed at IIASA to connect energy-water-land optimization with distributed hydrological modelling. Its repository contains linked Community Water Model and MESSAGEix workflows, with R scripts and processed input data for the Indus Basin. The current README identifies version 1.1 and changes to water, irrigation and policy scenarios; the GMD article describes version 1.0. Spatial coverage and temporal detail depend on the configured basin and optimization, so NEST is not a fixed global observation series. The public repository provides the coupling code free under Apache-2.0 and links the component documentation. It supports comparison of infrastructure investments and cross-sector constraints under socioeconomic and climate scenarios. A limitation is that the README notes data-sharing restrictions and supplies processed model inputs, so the code licence must not be assumed to remove upstream data restrictions. Existing model-iiasa-cwatm-community-water-model and model-messageix-framework describe its main components. This review did not run the workflows or retrieve the processed input bundle.
